headline: Frontlines Shift as Six Sectors Surge
war_summary: Three hours after the last edition the map shows a reshuffling of the most volatile theatres. Stlican Shelf remains the busiest sector, logging forty‑three ownership changes in the past day though the two‑hour tempo has fallen to zero from a prior ten flips; six flips occurred in the last six hours. Weathered Expanse has awakened, recording six flips in the latest two‑hour window and twenty‑three overall, a sharp rise from its earlier lull. Deadlands now reports three recent flips and eighteen daily, up from two and eleven previously. Godcrofts, quiet in the last two hours, still shows two flips in the past six hours and ten in the day. Callahans Passage, which flared briefly, has slipped to zero flips in the newest two‑hour slice but retains three in six hours. Linn Mercy, though devoid of base turnovers, exhibits accelerating casualty streams — 297 colonial and 315 warden losses per hour — and a climbing enlistment rate of thirty‑five per hour. Casualty rates are climbing on Stlican, Callahans, Weathered, Linn Mercy and Terminus, while enlistments surge at Callahans (56/hr) and Kings Cage (10/hr) but dip on Weathered (31/hr) and Stlican (26/hr). The deep Warden interior and the Colonial‑held southern fringe remain static with no base turnovers.
